status.title: We're at the Beginning
status.text1: ARVEN PLATFORM is in early development. We're shipping a pilot version Q4 2026.
status.text2: If you're skeptical of "disruptive AI" claims: fair. We're building compliance tools, not disruption mythology. Real companies piloting with us are seeing 40–60% faster audit cycles and 70% lower cost per assessment.

pilot.title: Pilot Program
pilot.transparency: We're transparent about delays. Blockers: NIS2 test data, multi-language reports.

about.title: About ARVEN
about.p1: ARVEN PLATFORM is developed by a team of compliance engineers, lawyers, and security researchers in Ukraine & Poland.
about.p2: We built this because we saw the gap: compliance is a solved problem (checklists, frameworks exist), but manual audits are expensive and slow. Most companies default to: ignore until regulator knocks.
about.p3: Our goal: make compliance automated, affordable, and honest. Not sell fear or "full-stack AI magic." Just faster, cheaper audits backed by real frameworks and verified sources.
